title: Source-backed T3 inventory versus current Agent Bus showcase

comparison.researchScope: 19 umbrella rows; original source-backed versus documented statuses retained. This is not a complete parity denominator or a T3 runtime test.

materialGaps.title: Owned starter scope is not arbitrary repository development
materialGaps.detail: Generated checklist/Rally files, four project tools and fixed static recipes omit existing repositories/worktrees/dependencies/general shell/SCM flow.

materialGaps.title: No durable District thread orchestration parity
materialGaps.detail: One-shot scoped runs do not imply resume/fork/steer queue, portable context or search/archive/snooze lifecycle.

materialGaps.title: Provider readiness is not discovered account capacity
materialGaps.detail: Two District providers and explicit model/effort; authentication, quota and catalog remain unchecked. Legacy stats are separate.

materialGaps.title: Permissions and delegated agent scope differ
materialGaps.detail: Fixed in-project capabilities are useful; no equivalent live provider approvals, project-scoped external-client grants or one-use secret flow.

materialGaps.title: Host surfaces are narrower
materialGaps.detail: No full web/mobile, remote managed host/browser/device hub, PTY/editor/attachment surface. Preview and VM message transport are separate bounded features.

materialGaps.title: Scheduling and platform lifecycle are separate
materialGaps.detail: Legacy opt-in Steward cadence is not durable District automation; updater/background/service/worktree cleanup parity is absent.

materialGaps.title: Showcase adapter and continuous handoff must be qualified
materialGaps.detail: Root source now normalizes run.steps/run.checks and dynamic checkPlan/kind/totals, routes actual scoped phases and pins latest/unresolved runs across seven projects. Frozen-candidate native handoff, phase travel, history suppression, preview/recovery and disposal remain gates.

independentReview.receivedFindings: Specialist source review agrees: narrow starters, fresh sessions, fixed recipes, byte checkpoints, absent approval/delegation/PTY/editor/attachment/account discovery/scheduler parity. Legacy features must be inventoried separately.
independentReview.currentCandidateGate: SC-19/root native and provider qualification remain separate; this document never grants all parity.
independentReview.finding: Historical SC10-F01 (five-check project shown0/6) is source-fixed by root's published checkPlan and dynamic consumer; current native qualification remains pending.

marketingCaveats: Pinned T3 marketing names six harnesses but source registers nine driver families; registration does not establish uniform capabilities.
Pinned T3 permits shared/existing worktrees and projectless scratch; do not require every thread to have a branch.
No quota caps is a marketing claim, not proof of unlimited provider allowance.
Source presence and documented mobile/device features do not establish released-client or runtime parity.
prohibitedClaims: CLI installed means authenticated or quota ready
Walking or thruster light proves work
A recipe/source pass proves browser behavior or owner artistic acceptance
An old saved pass is a new completion
Legacy bus capabilities are absent app-wide because not in the District
A supplied starter was AI-generated from the prompt
